Downtown Sioux Falls.name: Downtown Sioux Falls
Downtown Sioux Falls.description: Phillips Avenue retail and office core with the Levitt Shell, the Washington Pavilion, and high-value adaptive-reuse and mixed-use permitting.

Falls Park.name: Falls Park
Falls Park.description: Big Sioux riverfront around Falls Park with hotel and entertainment investment and the Cherapa Place mixed-use corridor.

East Bank / Arena District.name: East Bank / Arena District
East Bank / Arena District.description: East of the river with the Denny Sanford PREMIER Center, the Levitt adjacency, and residential infill and entertainment-adjacent commercial.

All Saints / Eastside.name: All Saints / Eastside
All Saints / Eastside.description: Historic east-side neighborhoods with tree-lined blocks, steady single-family renovation, and the Augustana University adjacency.

Western Sioux Falls.name: Western Sioux Falls
Western Sioux Falls.description: Western growth corridor with new subdivisions, the Sanford Health western campus expansion, and steady new-build residential permitting.

Empire Mall / Southwest.name: Empire Mall / Southwest
Empire Mall / Southwest.description: Empire Mall retail node and the 41st Street commercial strip with tenant-improvement and big-box commercial permitting.

Southern Sioux Falls.name: Southern Sioux Falls
Southern Sioux Falls.description: Southside growth area along Minnesota Avenue and Louise Avenue with master-planned subdivisions and strong new-home permit volume.

Marion Road / Southeast.name: Marion Road / Southeast
Marion Road / Southeast.description: Southeast residential belt along Marion Road with subdivision infill, schools, and community-serving commercial.

North Sioux Falls.name: North Sioux Falls
North Sioux Falls.description: Northern industrial and gateway corridor with logistics, the airport adjacency, and commercial-industrial permitting.
